ayahs.3: Ke be-shak aap paighambaron mein se hain.
ayahs.5: Yeh Quran Allah zabardast meharbaan ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai.
ayahs.6: Taake aap aise logon ko daraayen jin ke baap-daada nahin daraaye gaye the, so (isi wajah se) yeh ghaafil hain.
ayahs.7: Un mein se aksar logon par baat saabit ho chuki hai so yeh log imaan na laayenge.
ayahs.8: Hum ne un ki gardanon mein tauq daal diye hain phir woh thodiyon tak hain, jis se un ke sar oopar ko ulat gaye hain.
ayahs.9: Aur hum ne ek Aad un ke saamne kar di aur ek Aad un ke peechhe kar di, jis se hum ne un ko dhaank diya so woh nahin dekh sakte.
ayahs.10: Aur aap un ko daraayen ya na daraayen dono baraabar hain, yeh imaan nahin laayenge.
ayahs.11: Bas aap to sirf aise shakhs ko dara sakte hain jo naseehat par chale aur Rahman se be-dekhe dare, so aap us ko maghfirat aur ba-waqaar ajr ki khushkhabriyan suna dijiye.
ayahs.12: Be-shak hum murdon ko zinda karenge, aur hum likhte jaate hain woh aamaal bhi jin ko log aage bhejte hain aur un ke woh aamaal bhi jin ko peechhe chhod jaate hain, aur hum ne har cheez ko ek waazeh kitaab mein zabt kar rakha hai.
ayahs.13: Aur aap un ke saamne ek misaal (yaani ek) basti walon ki misaal (us waqt ka) bayaan kijiye jab ke us basti mein (kai) Rasool aaye.
ayahs.14: Jab hum ne un ke paas do ko bheja so un logon ne (awwal) dono ko jhutlaaya phir hum ne teesre se taaeed ki so un teenon ne kaha ke hum tumhare paas bheje gaye hain.
ayahs.15: Un logon ne kaha ke tum to hamari tarah maamooli aadmi ho aur Rahman ne koi cheez naazil nahin ki. Tum nira jhooth bolte ho.
ayahs.16: Un (Rasoolon) ne kaha hamara Parwardigaar jaanta hai ke be-shak hum tumhare paas bheje gaye hain.
ayahs.17: Aur hamare zimme to sirf waazeh taur par pahuncha dena hai.
ayahs.18: Unhon ne kaha ke hum to tum ko manhoos samajhte hain. Agar tum baaz na aaye to hum pattharon se tumhara kaam tamaam kar denge aur tum ko hamari taraf se sakht takleef pahunchegi.
ayahs.19: Un Rasoolon ne kaha ke tumhari nahoosat tumhare saath hi lagi hui hai, kya is ko nahoosat samajhte ho ke tum ko naseehat ki jaaye balke tum hadd se nikal jaane wale log ho.
ayahs.20: Aur ek shakhs (is) shehar ke aakhri hisse se daudta hua aaya kehne laga ke ae meri qaum! Un Rasoolon ki raah par chalo.
ayahs.21: Aise logon ki raah par chalo jo tum se koi muawaza nahin maangte aur woh raah-e-raast par hain.
ayahs.22: Aur mujhe kya ho gaya hai ke main us ki ibaadat na karoon jis ne mujhe paida kiya aur tum sab isi ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.23: Kya main use chhod kar aison ko mabood banaoon ke agar (Allah) Rahman mujhe koi nuqsaan pahunchaana chaahe to un ki sifaarish mujhe kuchh bhi nafa na pahuncha sake aur na woh mujhe bacha saken.
ayahs.24: Phir to main yaqeenan khuli gumraahi mein hoon.
ayahs.25: Meri suno! Main to (sachche dil se) tum sab ke Rabb par imaan la chuka.
ayahs.26: (Is se) kaha gaya ke jannat mein chala ja, kehne laga kaash! Meri qaum ko bhi ilm ho jaata.
ayahs.27: Ke mujhe mere Rabb ne bakhsh diya aur mujhe ba-izzat logon mein se kar diya.
ayahs.28: Is ke baad hum ne us ki qaum par aasman se koi lashkar na utaara, aur na is tarah hum utaara karte hain.
ayahs.29: Woh to sirf ek zor ki cheekh thi ke yakayak woh sab ke sab bujh-bujha gaye.
ayahs.30: (Aise) bandon par afsos! Kabhi bhi koi Rasool un ke paas nahin aaya jis ki hansi unhon ne na udaayi ho.
ayahs.31: Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke un ke pehle bahut si qaumon ko hum ne ghaarat kar diya ke woh un ki taraf laut kar nahin aayenge.
ayahs.32: Aur nahin hai koi jamaat magar yeh ke woh jama ho kar hamare saamne haazir ki jaayegi.
ayahs.33: Aur un ke liye ek nishaani (khushk) zameen hai jis ko hum ne zinda kar diya aur is se ghalla nikaala jis mein se woh khaate hain.
ayahs.34: Aur hum ne is mein khajooron ke aur angoor ke baaghaat paida kar diye, aur jin mein hum ne chashme bhi jaari kar diye hain.
ayahs.35: Taake (log) is ke phal khaayen, aur is ko un ke haathon ne nahin banaaya. Phir kyun shukr-guzaari nahin karte.
ayahs.36: Woh paak zaat hai jis ne har cheez ke jode paida kiye khwaah woh zameen ki ugaayi hui cheezen hon, khwaah khud un ke nufoos hon khwaah woh (cheezen) hon jinhein yeh jaante bhi nahin.
ayahs.37: Aur un ke liye ek nishaani raat hai jis se hum din ko kheen ch dete hain to woh yakayak andhere mein reh jaate hain.
ayahs.38: Aur sooraj ke liye jo muqarrar raah hai woh isi par chalta rehta hai. Yeh hai muqarrar karda ghaalib, ba-ilm Allah Taala ka.
ayahs.39: Aur chaand ki hum ne manzilen muqarrar kar rakhi hain, yahaan tak ke woh laut kar puraani tehni ki tarah ho jaata hai.
ayahs.40: Na aaftaab ki yeh majaal hai ke chaand ko pakde aur na raat din par aage badh jaane wali hai, aur sab ke sab aasman mein tairte phirte hain.
ayahs.41: Aur un ke liye ek nishaani (yeh bhi) hai ke hum ne un ki nasal ko bhari hui kashti mein sawaar kiya.
ayahs.42: Aur un ke liye isi jaisi aur cheezen paida kin jin par yeh sawaar hote hain.
ayahs.43: Aur agar hum chaahte to unhein dubo dete. Phir na to koi un ka faryaad-ras hota na woh bachaaye jaayen.
ayahs.44: Lekin hum apni taraf se rahmat karte hain aur ek muddat tak ke liye unhein faaide de rahe hain.
ayahs.45: Aur un se jab (kabhi) kaha jaata hai ke agle pichhle (gunaahon) se bacho taake tum par rahm kiya jaaye.
ayahs.46: Aur un ke paas to un ke Rabb ki nishaaniyon mein se koi nishaani aisi nahin aayi jis se yeh be-rukhi na baratte hon.
ayahs.47: Aur un se jab kaha jaata hai ke Allah Taala ke diye hue mein se kuchh kharch karo, to yeh kuffar imaan walon ko jawab dete hain ke hum unhein kyun khilaayen? Jinhein agar Allah Taala chaahta to khud khila-pila deta, tum to ho hi khuli gumraahi mein.
ayahs.48: Woh kehte hain ke yeh waada kab hoga, sachche ho to batlaao.
ayahs.49: Unhein sirf ek sakht cheekh ka intezaar hai jo unhein aa pakdegi aur yeh baaham ladaai-jhagde mein hi honge.
ayahs.50: Us waqt na to yeh wasiyat kar sakenge aur na apne ahl ki taraf laut sakenge.
ayahs.51: To Soor ke phoonke jaate hi sab ke sab apni qabron se apne Parwardigaar ki taraf (tez tez) chalne lagenge.
ayahs.52: Kahenge haaye haaye! Hamein hamari khwaabgaahon se kis ne utha diya. Yehi hai jis ka waada Rahman ne diya tha aur Rasoolon ne sach sach keh diya tha.
ayahs.53: Yeh nahin hai magar ek cheekh ke yakayak saare ke saare hamare saamne haazir kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.54: Pas aaj kisi shakhs par kuchh bhi zulm na kiya jaayega aur tumhein nahin badla diya jaayega, magar sirf un hi kaamon ka jo tum kiya karte the.
ayahs.55: Jannati log aaj ke din apne (dilchasp) mashghalon mein hashshaash-bashshaash hain.
ayahs.56: Woh aur un ki biwiyan saayon mein masahriyon par takiya lagaaye baithe honge.
ayahs.57: Un ke liye jannat mein har qism ke meway honge aur bhi jo kuchh woh talab karen.
ayahs.58: Meharbaan Parwardigaar ki taraf se unhein salaam kaha jaayega.
ayahs.59: Ae gunaahgaaro! Aaj tum alag ho jaao.
ayahs.60: Ae aulaad-e-Aadam! Kya main ne tum se qaul-qaraar nahin liya tha ke tum shaitaan ki ibaadat na karna, woh to tumhara khula dushman hai.
ayahs.61: Aur meri hi ibaadat karna. Seedhi raah yehi hai.
ayahs.62: Shaitaan ne to tum mein se bahut saari makhlooq ko behka diya. Kya tum aql nahin rakhte.
ayahs.63: Yehi woh dozakh hai jis ka tumhein waada diya jaata tha.
ayahs.64: Apne kufr ka badla paane ke liye aaj is mein daakhil ho jaao.
ayahs.65: Hum aaj ke din un ke munh par mohren laga denge aur un ke haath hum se baaten karenge aur un ke paaon gawaahiyan denge, un kaamon ki jo woh karte the.
ayahs.66: Agar hum chaahte to un ki aankhen be-noor kar dete phir yeh raste ki taraf daudte phirte lekin unhein kaise dikhaayi deta?
ayahs.67: Aur agar hum chaahte to un ki jagah hi par un ki sooraten maskh kar dete phir na woh chal phir sakte aur na laut sakte.
ayahs.68: Aur jise hum boodha karte hain use paidaishi haalat ki taraf phir ulat dete hain kya phir bhi woh nahin samajhte.
ayahs.69: Na to hum ne is paighambar ko sher sikhaaye aur na yeh is ke laaiq hai. Woh to sirf naseehat aur waazeh Quran hai.
ayahs.70: Taake woh har us shakhs ko aagaah kar de jo zinda hai, aur kaafiron par hujjat saabit ho jaaye.
ayahs.71: Kya woh nahin dekhte ke hum ne apne haathon se banaayi hui cheezon mein se un ke liye chaupaaye (bhi) paida kar diye, jin ke yeh maalik ho gaye hain.
ayahs.72: Aur un mawaashiyon ko hum ne un ka taabe-farmaan bana diya hai jin mein se baaz to un ki sawaariyan hain aur baaz ka gosht khaate hain.
ayahs.73: Unhein un se aur bhi bahut se faaide hain, aur peene ki cheezen. Kya phir (bhi) yeh shukr ada nahin karenge?
ayahs.74: Aur woh Allah ke siwa doosron ko mabood banaate hain taake woh madad kiye jaayen.
ayahs.75: (Haalaanke) un mein un ki madad ki taaqat hi nahin, (lekin) phir bhi (mushrikeen) un ke liye haazir-baash lashkari hain.
ayahs.76: Pas aap ko un ki baat ghamnaak na kare, hum un ki posheeda aur alaaniya sab baaton ko (ba-khoobi) jaante hain.
ayahs.77: Kya insan ko itna bhi maloom nahin ke hum ne use nutfe se paida kiya hai? Phir yakayak woh sareeh jhagdaalu ban baitha.
ayahs.78: Aur us ne hamare liye misaal bayaan ki aur apni (asal) paidaish ko bhool gaya, kehne laga un gali-sadi haddiyon ko kaun zinda kar sakta hai?
ayahs.79: Aap jawab dijiye! Ke unhein woh zinda karega jis ne unhein awwal martaba paida kiya hai, jo sab tarah ki paidaish ka ba-khoobi jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.80: Wahi jis ne tumhare liye sabz darakht se aag paida kar di jis se tum yakayak aag sulgaate ho.
ayahs.81: Jis ne aasmanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai kya woh un jaison ke paida karne par qaadir nahin, be-shak qaadir hai. Aur wahi to paida karne wala daana (beena) hai.
ayahs.82: Woh jab kabhi kisi cheez ka iraada karta hai use itna farma dena (kaafi hai) ke ho ja, woh isi waqt ho jaati hai.
ayahs.83: Pas paak hai woh Allah jis ke haath mein har cheez ki baadshaahat hai aur jis ki taraf tum sab lautaaye jaaoge.
